Determination

The
A4 - LDH
of
each

purified

an
agarose - oxamate

column

( Yancey
and
Somero
1978 ) .
A
homogenate
of
the
white
muscle
of
each

was

allowed
to
pass
down
the
oxamate
affinity
column ,
with
NADH
present
in
excess
to

ensure
efficient
binding
of
the
LDH .
The
LDH
was
eluted
with
pyruvate ,
which

binds
the
protein
with
a
greater
affinity
than
oxamate ,
and
collected
in
fractions
of

approximately
3ml
each .
The
fractions
were
tested

LDH
activity ,

active

fractions
were
